issues.problem: The on-screen stat reads "12 CATS". The narration, caption and fact sheet all say 14 cats. A viewer will see the number contradict the voice-over.
issues.fix: Change the stat text from "12 CATS" to "14 CATS". Also check that the count-up animation ends on 14.

issues.problem: The big stat reads "<10 MIN". The narration and caption say "under twenty minutes" and the fact sheet says under 20 minutes. The on-screen figure is wrong and contradicts the audio.
issues.fix: Change the stat to "<20 MIN", matching the narration. Alternatively use "~15 MIN", but then change the narration to match.

issues.problem: The parachute graphic is an emoji of a human skydiver. The cat floats separately below it with no connection to the canopy, so "she drifted down by parachute" looks odd. The scene also has no visible heart-monitor stat after the first beat.
issues.fix: Attach the cat to the parachute. Place the cat directly under the canopy at the same x and move with the canopy, or use a canopy-only drawing with the cat hanging from it. Replace the human skydiver emoji.

issues.problem: The narration says the launch was from the Sahara in Algeria. The background is green hills with a sunset sky, not a desert, and there is no Algeria label. Only a French flag is shown.
issues.fix: Swap the green hills for sand dunes. Add a small "SAHARA, ALGERIA" chip, e.g. at y≈0.55 under the date.

issues.problem: A sparkle overlaps the "KNOWN TO SURVIVE" text. A streak line crosses the medal emoji beside "BRONZE STATUE". The sub-labels sit tightly between the title and the cat.
issues.fix: Keep sparkles away from the text zones y 0.15–0.27. Add about 20 px of spacing between the "BRONZE STATUE" chip and the cat's ears.

issues.problem: In the later frame the cat sits on the rocket's nose cone and overlaps it. The "1963" text floats alone in the middle. The hook works, but the visual is a little cluttered.
issues.fix: Move the cat to about x 0.3, y 0.45 and keep it clear of the rocket tip. Or place the cat inside or beside the rocket window.

fact_check:
Two on-screen numbers contradict the narration and fact sheet. Scene 2 shows "12 CATS" but the sheet says 14. Scene 5 shows "<10 MIN" but the sheet and narration say under 20 minutes.
Supported by the fact sheet: the 18 Oct 1963 date, the Véronique rocket, the Sahara/Algeria launch, the French flag, 9.5 g being almost double Apollo, the Paris stray tuxedo cat, the Strasbourg bronze statue, the NASA-funded cat twist research, kittens floating upside-down, the 25–150 Hz purr, and lions and tigers roaring.
The "7.9 g → 9.5 g" frames are a count-up animation and are fine.
The script avoids the "first animal" claim, the euthanasia detail and an IST launch time.
